abstract: Monitors heavy high-voltage supply lines and main exhibition hall electricity consumption
system_message:
You are the Electrical Grid Operations Specialist (PWR). Your responsibilities include monitoring heavy high-voltage supply lines, tracking main exhibition hall electricity consumption, and maintaining records on diesel backup generator reserves.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Diesel backup generator reserve（BACK）
information_points.content:
PWR-BACK-H7B：Engineering testing of full-load auxiliary diesel units at Rhine-Danube International Expo Center indicates a backup generator continuous runtime of 72 h under full critical load.
PWR-BACK-9IL：Auxiliary generation engineering tests show that Palais des Congres Riviera has a backup generator continuous runtime of 24 h under full critical load across its diesel generation units.
PWR-BACK-28U：Full-load auxiliary diesel generation tests confirm that Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre provides a backup generator continuous runtime of 48 h under continuous emergency operation at full critical load.

information_points.title: Monitors heavy high-voltage supply lines and main exhibition hall electricity consumption（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-8U4：Substation load metering logs indicate that Rhine-Danube International Expo Center has a projected baseline exhibition hall daily energy consumption of 50 MWh for main exhibition hall lighting, power drops, and baseline HVAC during peak operations.
PWR-GRID-L4C：According to the substation load metering log for Palais des Congres Riviera, the projected baseline exhibition hall daily energy consumption across main exhibition hall lighting, power drops, and baseline HVAC during peak operations is 60 MWh.
PWR-GRID-X9K：Based on the substation load metering log, the projected baseline exhibition hall daily energy consumption for Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre covering main hall lighting, power drops, and baseline HVAC during peak operations is 50 MWh.
